tokens.name: soccer-green
tokens.usage: Main brand colour (MAIN BRAND). Large brand fields, the green accent word, markers. Text on it: night-pitch-green (8.9:1), never white.

tokens.name: concrete-grey
tokens.usage: Base background (BG-BASE) of pages and product packshots. Text on it: night-pitch-green (13.0:1).

tokens.name: night-pitch-green
tokens.usage: Text colour and dark fields (BG-TEXT). Replaces Tarmac Black. Reads as black on a dimmed screen but stays in the brand's green family. Text on it: concrete-grey (13.0:1) or white.

tokens.name: basketball-red
tokens.usage: Buttons and small signals. White text on it is 4.3:1: only for large, bold text such as buttons (3:1 floor), never for body copy. Night-pitch-green on it is 4.4:1.

tokens.name: tour-de-yellow
tokens.usage: Accent. Text on it: night-pitch-green (10.7:1), never white.

tokens.name: beachball-volley-beige
tokens.usage: Warm base and accent. Text on it: night-pitch-green (13.7:1).

tokens.name: marathon-blue
tokens.usage: Accent and focus ring. White on it: 5.3:1. As text colour on concrete-grey only 3.7:1: bold 19px+ or with underline.

tokens.name: olympic-pool-blue
tokens.usage: Light accent, info panels. Text on it: night-pitch-green (10.1:1).

tokens.name: stuntpark-grey
tokens.usage: Neutral accent, dividers. Text on it: night-pitch-green (6.3:1). White on it is 3.0:1, large text only.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Text on basketball-red (large and bold only), on marathon-blue and on night-pitch-green; logo ink on dark fields.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and section background. Light theme: concrete-grey. Dark theme (data-theme=dark on a section): night-pitch-green. Text: ink.

tokens.name: surface-warm
tokens.usage: Second background for alternating sections. Light theme: beachball-volley-beige. In the dark theme it equals surface. Text: ink.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings, icons and the logo on surface and surface-warm (13.0:1 and above) in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Brand fields and the green accent word. On surface (concrete-grey) it is a mark, not text: keep any text on it ink.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and the red accent word. Pair with on-action.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label colour on action. 4.3:1: large bold button labels only.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 3px solid, 2px offset. 3.7:1 on concrete-grey, 3.5:1 or more on night-pitch-green; meets the 3:1 floor for marks.

tokens.name: aluminium-light
tokens.usage: Light end of the aluminium plate gradient. Only used on SpecPlate.

tokens.name: aluminium-mid
tokens.usage: Darker end of the aluminium plate gradient. Only used on SpecPlate.

tokens.name: aluminium-engrave
tokens.usage: Engraved text and lines on the aluminium plate (6.6:1 on aluminium-mid, higher on aluminium-light). Only used on SpecPlate.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline. Uppercase. One accent word in outline.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Small headings, numerals, plate titles. Uppercase.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels. Uppercase, upright (not italic), 0.15em tracking.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small uppercase label above a headline or on a plate.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Kids grow up outside, with friends they haven't met yet.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Built to be used hard, not admired from a distance.
styles.usage: Running text. Important words in Archia Bold (700).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Base unit. Tight gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between small controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on a phone. Card padding on small cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding. Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between text blocks. Button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a phone.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop, hero.

tokens.name: cut-sm
tokens.usage: Notch on a small plate card and the spec plate (all four corners).

tokens.name: cut-md
tokens.usage: Notch on a standard plate card (all four corners, like the corners of a goal).

tokens.name: cut-lg
tokens.usage: Notch on a large plate card (all four corners).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything except the button: cards, plates, images, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons only (and chips beside each other).
